# Wreath

> Wreath is a Python 3.14-first ASGI framework with an optional native HTTP/1.1,
> HTTP/2, and HTTP/3 server. The public API is literal: each feature lives in the
> module its name implies. Pre-1.0; correctness and ASGI semantics come before
> optimization, and the native implementation is a faster twin of a pure-Python
> reference (force it with WREATH_PURE=1).

## Start here

- [Home](index.md): what Wreath is and why.
- [Getting started](getting-started/index.md): install and first app.
- [Deployment](getting-started/deployment.md): project layout, running behind ASGI or the native server.

## Coming from FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLModel, or Alembic

Read these first if you (or the code you are translating) use the FastAPI stack.

- [Wreath for FastAPI developers](from-fastapi/index.md): the same app in both dialects; full equivalence table; the deliberate differences (request is always the first handler parameter; markers live in Annotated with plain Python defaults; no response_model; errors are RFC 9457 problem+json, not {"detail": ...}; docs are opt-in via enable_docs(); TestClient is async and responses expose .status).
- [Pydantic and validation](from-fastapi/pydantic.md): BaseModel → dataclass or ORM-model bodies (extra fields always rejected); Field(ge/le) → Query(minimum/maximum/overflow) and ORM check= constraints; validators → narrow()/@rule; BaseSettings → wreath.config.load_env + WREATH_* + required_env.
- [SQLModel, SQLAlchemy, and the ORM](from-fastapi/sqlmodel.md): Model(table=...) with explicit PG types and NOT NULL defaults; Annotated[Session, FromORM(...)] instead of a session dependency; Hero.select().where(...) queries; loading is always explicit (no lazy N+1); no create_all — startup validation only.
- [Alembic and migrations](from-fastapi/alembic.md): the full single-schema loop ships — wreath migrations detect/check/generate/show/status/apply and a first-class inverse `down` (derived in metal from the same artifact; refuses to strand live ORM code unless --force). Keep Alembic only for MANUAL objects (composite constraints, full FK actions, expression/partial indexes) and tenant-fleet execution.

## Guides (one per extension)

- [Routing](guides/routing.md): app and Router, route decorators, composition.
- [Requests and responses](guides/requests-responses.md): the Request, and every response type.
- [Binding and validation](guides/binding.md): typed parameters, validation, Depends.
- [Middleware](guides/middleware.md): the protocol and built-ins.
- [Auth](guides/auth.md): authentication (identity) and authorization (roles, permissions, and a built-in dependency-free Cedar engine: CedarPolicies parses at startup, native evaluation, forbid-overrides-permit, default deny; extensions/schema validation fail loudly at parse time).
- [WebSockets](guides/websockets.md), [Native server](guides/server.md), [Outbound HTTP and webhooks](guides/http-client.md).
- [Calling another service](guides/service-client.md): `ServiceClient` binds a base path and an auto-refreshing bearer token onto an origin-pinned `Client`.
- [PostgreSQL](guides/postgres.md) and [ORM](guides/orm.md): strict direction orm → postgres.
- [FastAPI and Alembic migration](guides/migrations.md): staged SaaS adoption of logical schemas and metal readiness resolution.
- [Templates](guides/templates.md), [Caching](guides/caching.md), [Compression](guides/compression.md), [Static files](guides/static-files.md).
- [Caching responses](guides/response-cache.md): `@cached` over a bounded in-process store — public/shared by default, never caches a cookie-setting or no-store/private response; pass `key` to scope it to a principal.
- [Idempotent writes](guides/idempotency.md): `IdempotencyMiddleware` replays the first response for a repeated `Idempotency-Key`, from a bounded in-process store — no Redis.
- [Configuration and state](guides/config-state.md), [OpenAPI and typed clients](guides/openapi-typegen.md), [API docs](guides/api-docs.md), [Testing](guides/testing.md).
- [Server-sent events](guides/sse.md) and [Forms and uploads](guides/forms.md): the response type and the multipart binding path.
- [Content negotiation](guides/content-negotiation.md): `serialize(request, data)` picks the format from `Accept` (q-values per RFC 9110 §12.5.1); JSON stays the default.
- [Durable jobs, messaging, and services](guides/jobs.md): PostgreSQL is the queue — no broker; the supervisor starts after databases and drains in-flight work on shutdown.
- [Task progress](guides/progress.md): a bounded in-process registry a slow task writes to and a status endpoint or stream reads.
- [Users](guides/users.md): registration, sessions, and the ready-made user router.
- [Object storage](guides/storage.md), [Pagination](guides/pagination.md), [Distributed locks](guides/distributed-locks.md): advisory locks and SingletonRunner come from the `wreath.postgres` facade.
- [Generating CRUD](guides/crud.md): `crud_router` / `Wreath.crud`, off by default (app-level + per-model opt-in); sensitive columns hidden unless `expose`d; per-operation `authorize={op: Access.roles/permissions/cedar/deny}` plus `object_authorizer` for row-level checks.
- [Building a docs site](guides/docs-ssg.md): `wreath docs build` — the native SSG (typed-Python config, no YAML), themes/feels, build-time charts, `:::` API reference; mints wreath's own docs.
- [JSONB and arrays](guides/jsonb-arrays.md): the ORM's PostgreSQL container types.
- [Health, flags, and versioning](guides/health-flags-versioning.md): probes, feature flags, API versions.
- [Observability](guides/observability.md): telemetry configuration, exporters, and the Flight Recorder in practice.
- [Auditing](guides/auditing.md): `wreath audit` runs a curated zero-dependency accessibility (WCAG 2.2 A/AA) and performance ruleset over generated HTML; see [the rule reference](reference/audit.md) for adding one.
- [Porting from FastAPI](guides/porting.md): `wreath port` analyzes an app statically and never imports it; report-only today.

## Reference

- One page per public module under [reference/](reference/app.md), generated from the code.
- [`wreath.migrations`](reference/migrations.md): metal-only readiness policy, configuration, and bounded fleet results. `resolve_fleet`/`TenantState` classify a whole tenant directory in one native call; `wreath.orm.TenantContext` binds a request's tenant schema/role transaction-locally (SET LOCAL search_path/ROLE) for isolated registries — tenant sessions require an explicit transaction.
- [Telemetry](reference/telemetry.md), [Recording policies](reference/recording.md), [Replay and fault injection](reference/replay.md): the Native Flight Recorder surfaces (recording is policy types only; no capture engine yet).
- [Reserved and in-progress surfaces](reference/roadmap.md): what genuinely isn't shipped — the migration DDL runner, the recording capture engine, isolated tenant session execution.

## For coding agents

- [Cookbook for agents](cookbook/agents/index.md): invariants, gates, verification discipline.
- [The gates](cookbook/agents/checks.md): wreath-check, pytest, ruff, ty, native lints, request-trace.
